body: Following the suggestion in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCalibrate.jl/pull/395#pullrequestreview-5926458688, this PR removes `ScalarCovariance`. In addition, we also make a breaking release of ClimaCalibrate.
title: Remove ScalarCovariance and make a breaking release

body:
First step towards completing https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCalibrate.jl/issues/372. This PR adds functionality to be able to log information at the end of each iteration of a calibration. This involves building a `CalibrationReport` consisting of multiple `AbstractReporter`s which can include `WalltimeReporter`, `TimeStepReporter`, `ErrorReporter`, `ParameterReporter`, and `EnsembleReporter`. Each reporter is responsible for logging one specific kind of information. Users can implement their own `AbstractReporter` and add it to the `CalibrationReport`.

## Example

The output of the last two iterations looks like this for a toy calibration:

```julia
┌ Info: Calibration report · iteration 4 · 2026-10-28T16:20:30
│   Walltime
│     iteration walltime:                  1 second

│     current algorithm time: 0.117

│     timestep history:       [0.00482, 0.0137, 0.0262, 0.0726]
│   Error
│     current loss:            8.96 (-67.7% from previous)
│     best loss:               8.96 (iteration 4)
│     loss history:            [131.0, 70.8, 27.7, 8.96]
│     current unweighted_loss: 0.0896 (-67.7% from previous)
```

## Questions

1. How will this be called? One way is to add this as a keyword argument or argument to the `calibrate` function. This allows us to call it when it is not at the end of an iteration.
2. Should the log be saved to a file? I am not sure about the benefits of a `report.md` that only store the logs produced by `CalibrationReport`.
3. Right only, I am assuming that this is called at the end of each iteration. Should there be support for calls to `CalibrationReport` pre and post iteration?

## Future Work

This includes logging information about the residuals, ClimaAnalysis specific information such what observations are used for the minibatch, and generating plots. There could also be support for structuring all of the logs in a `report.md` file with plots too.
